title: Causally supervised 5/10-coordinate recurrent memory in native TypedLoop
scientific_question: Does training the original 5,590-parameter native TypedLoop cell with addressed donor/recipient interchange gradients improve causal specificity of compact recurrent state beyond task-and-status supervision?

scope.native_architecture: Verbatim hash-pinned AF-02 NativeTeacher, 80 full working coordinates, 2 recurrent visits per event; model weights are unfrozen and trainable in every AF-03 arm
scope.starting_weights: For each seed, reuse identical AF-02 frozen native teacher weights with full manifest validation before training; each arm starts from identical copied weights
scope.codec: Shared LearnedCodec (tanh affine encoder, affine decoder) within atom and within rule type, each of five tokens has 1 or 2 code coordinates, giving 5 or 10 carried coordinates; 80-coordinate decoded working state remains resident
scope.basis: Identical train-only per-token-type weighted PCA, truncated to specified code width; both arms initialized independently and identically
scope.meaning: This trains branch-status causal memory on an explicitly addressed public graph. The host still supplies proof evidence and rules; it does not establish discovery of latent proofs in an unconstrained language model.

synthetic_tensor_only_diagnostics.delay5: Add one legitimate W event before G in AF-02 delay4; 16 recurrent visits; no new Lean host certificate
synthetic_tensor_only_diagnostics.delay8: Add four W events before G in AF-02 delay4; 22 recurrent visits; no new Lean host certificate

data.input_hashes: Reuse exact AF-02 canonical cases and their source/source-corpus hashes. No host copies count as independent neural inputs.
data.donor_pairs: Use AF-02 donor_pairs canonical oracle, selecting only changed-prefix-status donors with identical first-probed branch, depth, and schedule; retain exact composed target for every instance.
data.patch_boundary: Actual carried code after second visit of first P; patch atom and matching rule code for the addressed branch, then decode once, and continue recipient suffix.
controls: whole-code patch equals direct hybrid forward
same source weights and PCA for each arm
data.weights: Uniform canonical inputs; sample duplicates independently with a two-way changed-status donor choice; group by true event count and first-P cut before recurrence.

training.common_training: Identical source weights, PCA codec initialization, minibatch and donor RNG draws per seed/width/arm. Both model and codec receive gradients; report first causal step native cell gradient norm.
training.task: Cross-entropy on original-host chosen branch or STOP
training.causal: Status + 0.5 addressed-patch task CE from composed public history + 0.5 patch audit CE + 0.25 recipient-other-branch CE + 0.1 same-model stopgradient direct-hybrid probability MSE
training.comparison: Equal optimization steps; causal arm takes additional actual forwards and gradients. Report training time and parameter counts; this is not a compute-matched architecture superiority test.
training.checkpoints: Fixed final-step .pt and matching .npz exports. Save all source hashes, losses, train/dev predictions, seed/arm metadata before held-out evaluation.
training.stop_policy: Scientific failure does not change fit steps or training objective. Engineering smoke and any failed run are labelled separately.

evaluation.eligibility: For each seed/width/arm, train and dev task and each branch status accuracy >=0.95 separately in each preview order; both status baseline and causal arm must qualify to compare.
evaluation.primary_gate: Among eligible status and causal models, causal minus status addressed-patch first-branch accuracy >=0.05 on each primary heldout family; clean task decline <=0.02; causal untouched-other accuracy >=0.95; causal selectivity >=0.20; no extra clean tainted attempts in either family. All three width2 seeds must pass for aggregate pass; eligible failures yield aggregate fail; otherwise inconclusive.
evaluation.training_split_exclusion: No heldout family or synthetic extension may be inspected to change objectives, steps, hyperparameters or thresholds in this registration.
evaluation.independent_controls: Direct hybrid and whole-code patch logits must agree to <=2e-5; retain raw clean and intervention logits and actual patched codes. Use AF-02 compositional target oracle, not student-produced labels.
evaluation.scientific_interpretation: Interchange fidelity supports a causal encoding claim only for this addressed receipt-memory gym. Commuting probability outputs do not prove global state invertibility or latent proof search.
